description: This Java source file defines an abstract class RpcDownlinkRequestCallbackProxy that implements callback handling for RPC downlink requests in an LWM2M transport context within the Thingsboard platform. It manages RPC request lifecycle events such as sent, success, validation error, and error, and provides mechanisms to reply with responses or errors.

classes.name: RpcDownlinkRequestCallbackProxy
classes.description: An abstract class implementing callback handling for RPC downlink requests, managing request lifecycle events and responses.

methods.name: onSent
methods.description: Handles the event when an RPC request has been sent; updates client's last sent RPC ID and processes the sent status.

methods.name: onSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful RPC response; processes delivery status, sends success reply, and invokes callback if present.

methods.name: onValidationError
methods.description: Handles validation errors; sends validation error reply and invokes callback if present.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during RPC; manages timeout cases, sends error reply, and invokes callback if present.

methods.name: reply
methods.description: Constructs and sends an RPC response message based on the provided response body.

methods.name: sendRpcReplyOnSuccess
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented for sending a successful RPC reply.

methods.name: sendRpcReplyOnValidationError
methods.description: Sends a validation error reply with the provided message.

methods.name: sendRpcReplyOnError
methods.description: Sends an error reply based on the provided exception.
